title: In the same head
body:
Walking down toward the Rotunda,
I have Usurum in my headphones.

During the three minutes I was introducing myself to a song of theirs I didn't know,
my eyes caught a street sweeper
who was whistling—even though I couldn't hear him.

At that exact same moment, the point in the song arrived
where the singer whistles;
for a second and a half
I couldn't separate
what I was seeing from what I was hearing!

Then I realized that
the sounds of the city are not so different from the sounds
each of us hears within.

Two worlds aligned
and introduced themselves;
inside the same head.

y.f.
